mapper.insert: insert into company_review( review_id, company_id, communication_rate, price_rate, result_rate, schedule_rate, structure_type, area_pyeong, construction_field) values ( #{reviewId}, #{companyId}, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, #{structureType}, #{areaPyeong}, #{constructionField} )
mapper.select: select 1 from company_score_avg where company_id = #{companyId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into company_score_avg( company_id, company_review_count, sum_communication, sum_price, sum_result, sum_schedule, avg_communication, avg_price, avg_result, avg_schedule, avg_total_rate) values ( #{companyId}, 1, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, (#{communicationRate} + #{priceRate} + #{resultRate} + #{scheduleRate} ) / 4.0 )
mapper.update: update company_score_avg set sum_communication = sum_communication + #{communicationRate}, sum_price = sum_price + #{priceRate}, sum_result = sum_result + #{resultRate}, sum_schedule = sum_schedule + #{scheduleRate}, company_review_count = company_review_count + 1 where company_id = #{companyId}

update company_score_avg set avg_communication = sum_communication / company_review_count, avg_price = sum_price / company_review_count, avg_result = sum_result / company_review_count, avg_schedule = sum_schedule / company_review_count,
avg_total_rate = ( sum_communication + sum_price + sum_result + sum_schedule ) / 4 / company_review_count where company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: select company_id AS companyId, avg_communication AS avgCommunication, avg_price AS avgPrice, avg_result AS avgResult, avg_schedule AS avgSchedule, avg_total_rate AS avgTotalRate from company_score_avg where company_id = #{companyId}

select r.review_id AS reviewId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, c.structure_type AS structureType, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.construction_field AS constructionField, r.review_img AS reviewImg, r.review_content AS reviewContent, r.review_date AS reviewDate, r.review_modify AS reviewModify from company_review c join review r ON r.review_id = c.review_id join user_detail u ON r.user_id = u.user_id where c.review_id = #{reviewId} and c.is_deleted = false and r.is_deleted = false

select r.review_id AS reviewId, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.structure_type AS structureType, r.review_content AS reviewContent from company_review c join review r ON c.review_id = r.review_id where r.target_type = 'INTERIOR' and r.is_deleted = false and c.is_deleted = false order by r.review_modify desc

select r.review_id AS reviewId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS userNickName, c.structure_type AS structureType, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.construction_field AS constructionField, review_content AS reviewContent, review_date AS reviewDate, review_modify AS reviewModify from company_review c join review r ON c.review_id = r.review_id join user_detail u ON r.user_id = u.user_id where company_id = #{companyId} and r.is_deleted = false and c.is_deleted = false
select count(*) from company_review c join review r ON c.review_id = r.review_id where company_id = #{companyId} and c.is_deleted = false and r.is_deleted = false
select 1 from review r join company_review c ON c.review_id = r.review_id where r.review_id = #{reviewId} and r.user_id = #{userId} and c.is_deleted = false and r.is_deleted = false limit 1
mapper.update: update company_review set is_deleted = 1 where review_id = #{reviewId} and is_deleted = false
update review set review_content = #{reviewContent}, review_modify = now() where review_id = #{reviewId}

update company_score_avg set sum_communication = sum_communication - #{oldCommunicationRate} + #{newCommunicationRate}, sum_price = sum_price - #{oldPriceRate} + #{newPriceRate}, sum_result = sum_result - #{oldResultRate} + #{newResultRate}, sum_schedule = sum_schedule - #{oldScheduleRate} + #{newScheduleRate} where company_id = #{companyId}

update company_score_avg set avg_communication = sum_communication / company_review_count, avg_price = sum_price / company_review_count, avg_result = sum_result / company_review_count, avg_schedule = sum_schedule / company_review_count,
avg_total_rate = ( sum_communication + sum_price + sum_result + sum_schedule ) / 4 / company_review_count where company_id = #{companyId}

update company_score_avg set sum_communication = 0, sum_price = 0, sum_result = 0, sum_schedule = 0, company_review_count = 0,
avg_communication = 0, avg_price = 0, avg_result = 0, avg_schedule = 0, avg_total_rate = 0 where company_id = #{companyId}

update company_score_avg set sum_communication = sum_communication - #{oldCommunicationRate}, sum_price = sum_price - #{oldPriceRate}, sum_result = sum_result - #{oldResultRate}, sum_schedule = sum_schedule - #{oldScheduleRate}, company_review_count = company_review_count - 1 where company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: select r.review_id AS reviewId, c.communication_rate AS communicationRate, c.price_rate AS priceRate, c.result_rate AS resultRate, c.schedule_rate AS scheduleRate, c.structure_type AS structureType, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.construction_field AS constructionField, r.review_content AS reviewContent from company_review c join review r ON c.review_id = r.review_id where r.review_id = #{reviewId} and r.is_deleted = false and c.is_deleted = false
